 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Maxime Aubin: Dusty May on the main improvements he expects from Zaccharie Risacher: "He's still finding himself. He hasn't shot at all as well as he's capable of, or as he has in his career. I think with the way the team is built, there has to be a way to put him in short roll situations, as a decision-maker (…) But he's finding himself as someone who's capable of impacting every possession: through his activity (on defense), through his ball deflections, coming from the weak side to contest shots and cover his teammates. He plays hard, he's active, and in the future, I think all of that will count for a lot in making him one of the key pieces of this team."
